title: How to make a state spread to all enemies if it's applied to one target?

posts.author: jpanboi
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
it's as the title says, i was trying to make a DoT that's similar to genshin's "Overcharged" where
the state automatically spreads its effect to all enemies when applied to at least 1 of them but couldn't figure out how. any method or pointers would be really appreciated

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
You could use a a skill that calls a common event which then uses coitional branches?
Basically it will check if each enemy has the status effect if Yes add an event that changes enemy stats to that stat.

im unfamiliar with what genshin's "overcharged" is and googling it doesnt bring it up. Is the state supposed to spread to all target's when applied, or just the damage itself?
If the state itself is meant to be spread then you can do as already suggested above or you can use Yanfly's action sequences/skill core to make all skills that apply it apply it to all enemies regardless of scope. If its supposed to just be the damage then yanfly's Buffs and States plugin can let you make it so that when that when the turn ands, all troop members take damage from the state on the one enemy
Assuming this is MV. you posted it in MV Support but your profile says MZ
